messages:
Jin Park: quick update — brought up q4-13b-8bit with the speculative fastpath enabled on a couple of canary hosts. Initial perf: ~1.9x token/s vs baseline, latency p95 down ~22% for short prompts.
Matt R: nice. any quality diffs so far?
Jin Park: small regressions on some common-code completions. Example failure mode: replaces qualified imports with local variable names. See sample below.
Jin Park: ```
input: "from torch import nn\nclass Model(nn.Module):\n    def forward(self, x):"
baseline: "... def forward(self, x):\n    return x\n"
q4: "... def forward(self):\n    return x\n"
```
Sara L: ouch. is that tied to quant noise or the two-pass prefix mismatch?
Anita: my hunch: speculative predictor uses truncated logits from quantized model for next-token prefill, then late-bind stage uses higher-precision model; mismatch causes anchor drift. could reproduce with deterministic seed?
Jin Park: I reproduced w/ fixed seed. Looks like top-k probability mass shifts when using per-tensor scale w/ metric=bits. Suggested mitigations:
- tighten speculative threshold (prob_delta -> 0.02)
- increase warm-k to 6 for code-heavy workloads
- add sampling temperature clamp on predictor
Matt R: can we run small A/B with held-out codebench (1500 prompts)?
Jin Park: yes queued. plan: 25% traffic to fastpath canary, collect pass/fail and perplexity, eval with existing corpus + a new code-specific set. Timeline: end of day run, analysis tomorrow.
ops-bot: deploy canary q4-13b-8bit:canary -> success :white_check_mark: 
Sara L: logging note — capture (predictor_logits, final_logits) pairs for 1% of requests to analyze drift. privacy ok for codebench.
Anita: also log attention head L2 for early tokens, helps debug alignment.
Matt R: if quality doesn't meet threshold revert fastpath for code routes only. threshold: <0.5% degradation in exact match on code snippets.
Jin Park: agreed. will post raw numbers when run finishes. tagging @Sara L @Matt R @Anita for visibility :eyes: 
Sara L: :thumbsup: 
Anita: thanks — will prep analysis notebook
